expressions.title: The West Pakistan Rangers (Administration and Control) Order, 1972 (President's Order No. 19 of 1972)

relations.effect: Article 2 vests the superintendence, control and administration of the West Pakistan Rangers constituted under the Ordinance in the Federal Government: (a) the Provincial Government's powers under it are exercisable by the Federal Government, (b) references in it to the 'Provincial Government' and to the 'Governor of the Punjab' or 'of Sind' are construed as references to the Federal Government

printed_note.text: [This order may be read as an integral part of The Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959).]

article_2.text: 2. Vesting of superintendence, etc., of the West Pakistan Rangers in the Federal Government. Notwithstanding anything contained in the West Pakistan Rangers (Reconstitution) Order, 1971, or the West Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959, or any other law for the time being in force, the superintendence, control and administration of the West Pakistan Rangers constituted under the said Ordinance shall vest in the 1[Federal Government] and,― (a) all powers of the Provincial Government in relation to the West Pakistan Rangers shall be exercisable by the 1[Federal Government]; and (b) references in the said Ordinance to the “Provincial Government”, howsoever worded, and to the “Governor of the Punjab” or the “Governor of Sind” shall be construed as references to the 1[Federal Government].
